text:
rachel: Noticed a weird behavior when pinch-to-zoom on mobile: table columns reflow and sidebar auto-hides then shows causing header jump. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/pinch-zoom-jump.png
omar: Repro'd. Happens when user zooms slightly then releases; the layout bounce comes from recalculated breakpoints.
zee: On pinch browsers change layout viewport which flips media queries. Maybe we should debounce breakpoint changes while pinch is active.
pat: Also sidebar auto-hide is aggressive. If overlay mode is enabled the nav should remain hidden during pinch to avoid stacking context churn.
rachel: Idea: add a temporary global class `.is-zooming` during touch gestures and disable breakpoint-driven layout swaps for 300ms after touchend.
omar: Pseudocode: `ontouchstart -> setTimeout mark start; touchend -> setTimeout(remove,300)` then ignore media-query swaps while class present.
zee: Accessibility check: ensure text scaling still works for zoom-to-text and doesn't get blocked. Only debounce layout swaps, not zoom behavior.
pat: Also copy nit: collapsed sidebar tooltip says "Open" but gets clipped on tiny widths. Use shorter copy "Nav" and add `aria-label` "Open navigation".
rachel: QA list: iPhone SE Safari pinch, Pixel 4 Chrome pinch, screen-reader while zooming, large-font scaling.
ux-bot: Created ticket https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4012 "debounce breakpoint swaps during pinch/zoom" and flagged @omar @zee.
pat: I'll draft a tiny PR with `.is-zooming` guard and adjustments to sidebar tooltip copy. Tagging for review.
